turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My train got cancelled and I need to be at the airport by six.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, you have options. There's an airport bus in twenty minutes, or a taxi would get you there faster but cost a lot more. What do you want to do?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me talk to Leo for a bit, so please stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Leo, which one did you like better, the blue one or the grey one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The grey one drove nicer. The blue one felt kind of heavy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: But the blue one has a bigger boot. We need space for the dog.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: True. The dog doesn't care how it drives.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we go back and test drive them again tomorrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Let's do it in the morning, before the dealership gets busy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. I'll call them first thing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi again. The airport bus is still an option, or a taxi. What do you think?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The bus. I've got enough time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good. It leaves from the stop outside the main entrance, so head there now.
